Tosafot on Bava Batra 107b:2:1.hebrew: דמתורת מנה לא מפקי ליה - וליכא למימר דניזיל בתר בתראי, דלא גרעי ממנה, דיש לתפוס המועט, כדפ"ה:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 107b:2:1.english: "For they do not remove him [from the land] on the basis of [a claim of] a maneh" - And one cannot say that we should follow the later ones, [on the grounds] that they are not less than [a] maneh, since one must take the smaller [amount], as the commentary [of Rashbam] explains:

Tosafot on Bava Batra 107b:3:1.hebrew: מסתייה דקא טפינא [כולי האי] אחבראי - שכן הסדר, דשנים הפוחתים מדברים תחלה:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 107b:3:1.english: "It is enough for him that I exceed [by so much] over my fellow" - For this is the order: the two who reduce [the value] speak first.

Tosafot on Bava Batra 107b:4:1.hebrew: אדרבה האי ארעא מאה ותליסר ותילתא שויא - תימה לר"י: דהשתא אי לא הוי אלא תרי, דחד אמר מנה וחד אמר שלשים, הוה אמינא דמאה ועשרה שויא, דכן האמת נראה לכ"ע. והשתא דאיתיה להאי דפחות מכולהו, אמר תלתא ותילתא הוי טפי:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 107b:4:1.english: On the contrary, this land is worth one hundred thirteen and a third - It is puzzling to Rabbi Yitzchak: For now, if there were only two [appraisers], where one said a hundred (maneh) and one said thirty, I would have said that it is worth a hundred and ten, since this appears to be the truth to everyone. But now that there is this one who [says] less than all of them, he said that three and a third is more [than I would have thought].
